target.statement: Nav-R2 achieves 44.0% success rate (SR) on the OVON val-unseen split (open-vocabulary object-goal navigation).

compute.basis: The main result requires training a 7B vision-language model for 1280 H20-GPU-hours (64 GPUs) and evaluating a 7B VLM over many navigation episodes; both are infeasible on an 8-core CPU-only laptop within hours.

blockers: evaluation requires running a 7B VLM over many episodes
HM3D-OVON depends on HM3D simulator/scenes which require signed terms
no confirmed release of NavR2-CoT dataset, model weights, or training configs
title: Nav-$R^2$ Dual-Relation Reasoning for Generalizable Open-Vocabulary Object-Goal Navigation
